purpose: Official Cake Decorator comparator evidence for NYSC COURSE-050 and COURSE-051. Records describe documented curriculum only and do not establish equivalence, quality, delivery or labour demand.
status_note: No record has been human-verified yet. Every record must be checked against its official source by a researcher before publication.

country_group_gaps.developing_emerging: The existing India DGT Baker & Confectioner national curriculum is linked from the Baker dataset and provides substantial cake and icing evidence.
country_group_gaps.developed: The existing Singapore ITE Higher Nitec in Pastry & Baking delivered programme is linked from the Baker dataset and provides substantial cake-design and decoration evidence.

records.institution: Tertiary and Vocational Education Commission / National Apprentice and Industrial Training Authority
records.entry_as_published: For NVQ Level 03 Qualification- None; For NVQ Level 04 Qualification- None

modules.outcome_verbatim: This unit covers the competencies required to maintain pleasant and safe food handling area adhering to the standard operating procedures and company norms.

modules.title_verbatim: Prepare basic icing mixtures and toppings
Prepare advanced icing mixtures, toppings and syrups
Practice workplace communication and interpersonal relations
Practice occupational health and safety measures

scope_verbatim: Cake Decorator is the person who design and decorate cakes according to customers’ specifications while recommending customers the best solutions to achieve customer expectation.

source.publication_or_revision: Endorsed 27 January 2022; validated 2 December 2021; review date stated as 27 January 2025

verification.method: All 12 competency-unit titles and codes, the occupational definition and NVQ packaging were checked against the official NCS PDF (PDF page 6, printed page 1); the U01 descriptor was checked on PDF page 7, printed page 2; endorsement, validation, review and prerequisite details were checked on PDF page 64, printed page 59.
